summary:
Frontend-only re-test of /design-preview (6 routes + family dark) on the public URL with Playwright at 320/390/768/1024/1440. PASSED: (1) Typography: every h1/h2/h3 on every route computes to Plus Jakarta Sans. Body text, buttons, inputs, selects, metric values, times and lists compute to IBM Plex Sans. The preview-typeface select is gone. Only exception: 5 decorative

card titles on the index use Jakarta, which is fine because they act as headings. (2) Platform metrics: populated shows 3/2/2/1 with subtitles; loading shows 4 metric-*-loading skeletons and no values; empty shows all 0 with empty subtitles ('No centers yet', 'Nothing waiting for review', 'No centers on trial', 'None restricted'); error shows '—' with 'Couldn’t load · retry below'. trial-alert only appears when populated. Retry returns to populated with the alert back. (3) Scroll cues: child-tabs, specialty-switcher and preview-screens at 320 and 390 show a fade mask and a -scroll-right chevron. Clicking scrolls the strip and the left chevron appears. At the end data-overflow-right=false and the right chevron is removed. Left chevron works. No chevrons at 1440 (or 1024). (4) Dark flash: with /_next/static/chunks blocked (no hydration), ?theme=dark and localStorage tb-family-theme=dark both give html[data-family-theme=dark] and a shell background of rgb(13,18,38) with the Sun icon showing. Light gives rgb(250,248,245). theme-toggle switches immediately and persists after reload. The logo chip is white in dark and transparent in light. (5) No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == viewport) on all 7 route variants at all 5 widths. No console errors under normal loads. (6) Contrast: a programmatic WCAG check of all visible text on family light/dark (incl. the activity dialog, outcome labels and all 4 data states), platform, center, therapist, child and the index found no text pair under 4.5:1. Minimum was 4.54 in family light. (7) Keyboard: Tab reaches every focusable element on every route and all show a focus outline. The child tablist uses roving tabindex. Native dialogs (application, revoke) trap focus, close on Escape and return focus to the trigger. The notifications and account popovers close on Escape and return focus. (8) Iteration_2 regressions still fixed: notifications and account panels stay inside the viewport at 320/390 (x=16, w=288/358). Activity-dialog steps match the title (Mon/Fri Bubble breaths, Wed Sound hunt). Weekend logic is correct with the clock mocked to Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun: Sat/Sun show rest-state and a 'Rest day' detail, Friday's next appointment rolls to Monday. The Timeline/List toggle's selected state is clear (tint + ring + action color, aria-pressed). DEFECTS FOUND: see action_items.

ui_bugs.issue: role=dialog aria-modal=true, but opening it leaves focus on bottom-nav-more instead of moving it into the sheet, and focus is not trapped: Tab leaves the sheet (nav-account -> page body -> preview-link-direction...). After Escape, focus is left wherever it escaped to and is not returned to bottom-nav-more.

ui_bugs.component: Global focus ring in dark contexts
ui_bugs.issue: :focus-visible uses a fixed outline of 3px var(--tb-brand-action) #0F5692. Against family dark surfaces the non-text contrast is only 2.44:1 (#0D1226), 2.24:1 (#151B33) and 2.02:1 (#1C2342), and 2.38:1 on the dark preview bar (#0B1530). WCAG 1.4.11 asks for 3:1, so the ring is barely visible on theme-toggle, start-activity and the preview links in dark.

ArrowRight focus relies on the browser's native focus scrolling. At 320, focusing Sessions, Plans or Access leaves them partly off-screen or under the right fade and chevron (scrollLeft stays 0 when Sessions is focused; its right edge is at 352 while the strip ends at 304). Home/End keys are not supported (End stays on the current tab).

Overview: the 'Next session' and 'Family activity' inner cards are 19px wider than the panel's content box (right edge 304 vs 285) and sit on the outer card's right border. The cause is an implicit grid column ('grid gap-4' with no grid-cols-1) sized by nowrap content. Providers: the 'OT' SpecialtyTag sticks out past the provider card's border (right 302).
Staff rows (e.g. Hana Sato email line) extend about 10px into the card's right padding (295 vs 285).

integration_issues.issue: The applications tab counts stay 'Pending (2)' / 'Decided (2)' in the empty, error and loading states, while the metrics show 0 or '—'. This conflicts with the owner's rule that platform figures follow every data state.

The week, featured activity and next appointment are computed from new Date() during SSR. When the client date differs from the server date (user timezone around midnight; reproduced by mocking the client clock), React logs 'Text content did not match. Server: Picture talk Client: Bubble breaths' and the Next dev overlay shows '1 error'. Compute date-dependent content after mount, or derive it on the client only.

issues: The ErrorState panel keeps the light dangerSurface (#FDECEA pink) and a dark Retry button on the navy canvas. It reads as an unthemed light block in dark mode (contrast passes, but it isn't styled for dark).
'Pending applications' wraps to two lines, so its value sits about 6px lower than 'Active centers' in the same row. The values are not baseline-aligned.

The chevron buttons are 32x32, below the 44px touch target used elsewhere. specialty-switcher overflows at 768 (477 vs 444px), so a chevron appears for a 3-option control on tablet. Consider letting it wrap or fit at md.
The 3px outline with 2px offset on the focused tab is clipped top and bottom by the overflow-x-auto strip.

action_items: More sheet: on open, move focus into the sheet (e.g. more-sheet-close), trap Tab and Shift+Tab inside it, and return focus to bottom-nav-more on close or Escape.
Focus ring: use a theme-aware outline color in family dark and the preview bar, e.g. --fam-accent #5CCFDB or #7DB3E8, so the ring is at least 3:1 against #0D1226/#151B33/#1C2342/#0B1530.
Child tabs: in onKey call refs.current[next].scrollIntoView({inline:'nearest', block:'nearest'}) with scroll-padding about the fade width (40px) so the focused tab is fully visible. Add Home/End.

Child panel at 320: add grid-cols-1 or [&>*]:min-w-0 to the overview grid, and let the provider li wrap its tags (flex-wrap/min-w-0) so the 'OT' tag stays inside the card. Do the same min-w-0/truncate fix for center staff rows.
Platform: make the Pending/Decided tab counts follow preview-data-state (hide the counts in loading/error, show 0 in empty).
Family: avoid an SSR/client date mismatch by computing the week and featured activity after mount, or by passing a fixed date to both server and client.
Optional design polish: dark-themed ErrorState for family dark, baseline alignment of metric values, 44px chevron targets, keep specialty-switcher unclipped at 768.
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollStrip: the chevrons are aria-hidden with tabIndex=-1. That's fine for keyboard users, but focused tabs then need explicit scrollIntoView, because native focus scrolling does not account for the 40px mask and chevron.
AppShell more-sheet is a custom role=dialog without focus management. Reuse the native <dialog>.showModal() approach used by Dialog in states.tsx.

THEME_SCRIPT is rendered in the design-preview layout body. It works for full loads, but it won't run on client-side navigation into /design-preview from another layout (React does not execute injected scripts). AppShell then falls back to the dataset value, which may be unset. This is low risk today.
globals.css :focus-visible hard-codes --tb-brand-action for every context, including family dark. Use a CSS variable overridden in .theme-family-auto / html[data-family-theme=dark].

success_rate.frontend: 92% (5 of 7 requested feature areas fully pass; keyboard/focus and 320 alignment have defects)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Base https://therabridge.preview.emergentagent.com/design-preview. Dark-flash test: page.route('**/_next/static/chunks/**', abort), goto with wait_until=domcontentloaded, read getComputedStyle([data-testid=shell-family]).backgroundColor (expect rgb(13, 18, 38)). Weekend logic: page.clock.set_fixed_time(datetime) before goto. This triggers a hydration-mismatch overlay because server and client dates differ (a known issue, reported). Scroll cue attributes: data-overflow-left/right on [data-testid=child-tabs|specialty-switcher|preview-screens], chevrons <id>-scroll-left/right. Contrast was checked with a JS walker that blends layered backgrounds; all text passed AA. To check 320 inner-card overflow, compare child rects to section.right - paddingRight. The family activity title depends on the weekday.
rca of the issue: Child panel overflow: '<div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">' has no explicit column template below lg, so the implicit auto column takes the min-content of whitespace-nowrap tags and long text, which is wider than the 246px content box at 320. Focus ring: the single global :focus-visible rule uses brand action blue, which is a light-theme color. More sheet: a plain fixed div with role=dialog, with no focus() on open and no keydown Tab trap. Hydration mismatch: useWeek/nextAppt use new Date() during render on both server and client.
